# File Definition

## Summary
`FileDef` is the base class of file-backed cards — the file counterpart of
CardDef. Every typed file def (PNG, MP3, CSV, …) adopts it; the binary
content lives at the instance's file URL while the card carries name, size,
content type and rendering behavior.

## Invariants
- Instances are realm files first: deleting the file deletes the card.
- `createFileDef` picks the concrete subclass from the MIME type — uploads
  never need to name a type by hand.
- Renderers (File Image/Audio/Video/Object components) take any
  FileDef-backed model.

## Example
```ts
import { FileDef, createFileDef } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-api';

let file = await createFileDef({ file: upload, realm });
@field attachment = linksTo(FileDef);
```
